The Director General is the investigative arm of CCI responsible for probing violations of the Competition Act.

items: The Director General is specifically the investigative wing of the CCI, not a decision-making or adjudicating body.
Primary focus of DG probes is specifically targeted at violations under the Competition Act.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Director General (DG) functions as the official investigative arm of the Competition Commission of India (CCI).
The primary mandate of the Director General is to probe violations of the Competition Act.
